value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes Madera/Madera County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other PG&E-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value: The field inspector compares the installation to the printed Inspection Checklist on-site
Call (559) 661-5445 with the permit number, address, inspection type, and preferred date/time
AM slots run 8:00am-12:00pm; PM slots run 1:00pm-4:00pm
Reinspection fees apply if the site is unready or revisions are incomplete

value.notes: Inspection requests received before 4:00pm are scheduled for the next workday; requests received after 4:00pm are scheduled 2 days later.
